content: In Thai, texts do not contain markers that definitively identify sentence boundaries. Instead, written Thai usually uses a space as the vital element that separates text into sentences. However, there are three ways that spaces are used in this context BIBREF23 : before and after an interjection, before conjunctions, and before and after numeric expressions. Therefore, segmenting text into sentences cannot be performed simply by splitting a text at the spaces.

title: Thai sentence segmentation
